## Choosing inside the family

- **GPT Image 2.6 Flare:** The fast one of the newer pair: pick it for graphics, vector or transparent assets and quick rounds. Pick the high-detail sibling when detail and precise edits matter more than speed, and an older sibling only for saved work.
- **GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst:** The careful one of the newer pair: pick it for final pieces and precise edits. Pick the speed-focused sibling for drafts, and an older sibling only for saved work.
- **GPT Image 2.5 Flare:** The earlier fast sibling: fine for everyday graphics and text. Pick a newer sibling for vector or transparent output, larger sizes or marked-zone edits.
- **GPT Image 2:** Kept so saved jobs and presets still open. For new work pick one of its newer siblings.

## Pick something else when

- **GPT Image 2.6 Flare:** The most detail and the most precise edits: pick the high-detail sibling of this family.
- **GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst:** Quick drafts and many rounds of small tries: pick the speed-focused sibling or a fast model.
- **GPT Image 2.5 Flare:** Vector files, transparent backgrounds or animated output: pick a newer model of this family that exports them.
- **GPT Image 2:** New work: pick a current model, because the maker deprecated this one.
